description: Unverified observations from OCD Android reports of people's phones (observed/reports/, from every account alike), per device, carrier profile, software stack and entry. A report only points at an entry of OCD's data at one commit or release; it never changes an OCD value, a file under generated/ or a release, and it never makes a phone skip its own test. Nothing here is a support claim.

statuses.reported: Counted reports of people's phones, by result. Not checked by OCD: anyone can open an issue, and nothing checks who sent a report or whether the phone exists.
statuses.contested: At least one counted report measured a clean failure of the entry (the test ran and the phone's state came back). It asks the next phone to test the entry and a maintainer to look; it switches nothing off.
statuses.retested_by_ocd: Always null. No account or list gives a result a stronger status: every result reads "reported, not checked by OCD" (rule round 47, item 2). This field leaves the file once the app without it is on the phones.
